ICT Raptor AI combines market reading according to ICT and Smart Money Concepts with a chain of proprietary artificial intelligence. First it looks for the opportunity the way an institutional trader would, then it puts it to the test. An order goes out only if it passes every check.
<small>01 · THE READING</small>THE MARKET SEEN THROUGH INSTITUTIONAL EYES
The robot does not work on indicator crossovers. It reads what the big players look at: price structure, liquidity and the zones where the orders that matter went through.
It recognises market direction, breaks of structure and changes of character, across several timeframes at once.
It identifies the zones where other traders’ orders pile up and waits for them to be taken, instead of ending up inside them.
It marks the areas the price left with force and those left uncovered, where it is most likely to react again.
<small>02 · THE STRATEGIES</small>SIX ICT CELLS, EACH WITH ITS OWN TASK
Six independent strategies work on the same chart. Each has its own artificial intelligence model and signs its own orders: in the history you always know who opened what.
It recognises the structure, waits for the decisive displacement and enters only on the confirmed retracement.
It does not chase: it waits for the price to come back to the optimal entry zone.
Accumulation, manipulation, distribution. It enters on the third phase, on the side of those who set the trap.
The point where two reasons to enter overlap. Rare, and for that very reason heavy.
The price sweeps the liquidity, turns and takes off again. The cell enters after, not before.
When an institutional zone gives way, it changes sign. The cell marks it and waits for the return.
Not a single model: a chain in which each level answers a different question. If one level says no, the order does not go out. That is why the robot opens fewer trades than it could, and better ones.
Several neural networks look at the same signal and vote. The majority decides.
They discard the signals that look good but are not good enough.
It can say no even when all the others say yes.
It decides how much capital the trade deserves and how it should be managed.
Dedicated networks read upcoming economic data. Available on PLUS and PRIME.
<small>04 · THE MANAGEMENT</small>FIRST IT PROTECTS, THEN IT LETS IT RUN

Stop, target and trailing are measured on current volatility. The robot banks partials, moves the stop into profit when the market allows it and does not enter if spread and broker conditions are out of the ordinary.
Three markets that do not behave the same way: each has its own models and its own calibration. The robot works out by itself which one it is trading.
<small>06 · THE INFRASTRUCTURE</small>EVERYTHING IN A SINGLE FILE

The models are designed, trained and validated in-house, on market periods they never saw during training. They live inside the robot: no external dependencies, nothing to download, no server queried to decide.
